categories.main_business_segments: Longkou Union Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sales of organic pigments and extrusion-based ink. The company focuses on high-performance azo pigments used mainly in inks, coatings, plastics, and emerging fields such as electronic chemicals. It also produces extrusion-based inks as intermediates for high-grade offset printing inks.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced organic synthesis and physical processing technologies for pigment production, including diazotization, coupling reactions, pigment surface treatment, filtration, drying, and blending. It emphasizes proprietary technologies in pigment dispersion, green synthesis processes, and automation to ensure product quality and environmental compliance. The extrusion-based ink production uses vacuum kneading and phase transfer techniques to achieve high gloss and color strength.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large and medium-sized ink manufacturers domestically and internationally, such as DIC Corporation (SUNCHEMICAL), Yangzijing Ink, Hanghua Ink, Tianjin Toyo Ink, and Kede Education. The main end markets are printing inks (about 70% of pigment use), coatings, plastics, and emerging sectors like food packaging, cosmetics, electronics, and 3D printing materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and production facilities in Longkou City, Shandong Province. It serves domestic markets extensively and exports to multiple countries and regions globally, including Europe, North America, South America, the Middle East, and ASEAN countries benefiting from RCEP trade agreements.
categories.supply_chain_position: Longkou Union Chemical operates mainly in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, focusing on manufacturing organic pigments and ink intermediates. It procures raw materials from upstream petrochemical and coal chemical industries and supplies finished pigments and inks downstream to ink, coating, and plastic manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and product quality, investing heavily in R&D to develop environmentally friendly, high-performance, and functional pigments. It focuses on expanding applications in electronic chemicals and semiconductor materials, enhancing automation and digitalization in production, and strengthening intellectual property with numerous patents and participation in national standards formulation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of organic pigments and extrusion-based inks. The company sells products directly to end customers and through distributors and traders, with a majority of sales recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance domestically and upon customs clearance for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Longkou Union Chemical is a leading domestic producer of organic pigments, holding a significant market share in China and maintaining strong international competitiveness. It is the largest Chinese supplier and strategic partner of global ink giant DIC Corporation in China. The company competes with other major Chinese pigment manufacturers like Xinkai Technology and Shuangle Pigment, focusing on product performance, environmental compliance, and customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 534.6 million, a 24.8% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 56.4 million, up 66.8%. The company has shown steady growth in production volume and sales, with a stable asset base of about RMB 873 million and equity of RMB 729 million. R&D investment accounted for 4.53% of revenue, supporting ongoing innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, stable performance, and environmental friendliness, leveraging proprietary surface treatment and synthesis technologies to deliver pigments with superior color strength, dispersion, and durability. It offers customized solutions aligned with customer requirements and maintains rigorous quality control and after-sales technical support. Its extrusion-based inks provide high gloss and color strength tailored for premium printing applications, differentiating it in the competitive pigment market.
